SELECT
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='bedrijfsnaam'     THEN value END),'Mijn Bedrijf') AS bedrijfsnaam,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='kvk'              THEN value END),'') AS kvk,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='iban'             THEN value END),'') AS iban,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='adres'            THEN value END),'') AS adres,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='postcode'         THEN value END),'') AS postcode,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='stad'             THEN value END),'') AS stad,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='email'            THEN value END),'') AS email,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='telefoon'         THEN value END),'') AS telefoon,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='btw_nummer'       THEN value END),'') AS btw_nummer,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='accountant_email' THEN value END),'') AS accountant_email,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='logo_url'         THEN value END),'') AS logo_url
FROM settings
